notes: The official MBA page (current 2026-27 application cycle) lists 655 Median GMAT Score with no edition label and no class year, so per protocol neither gmat_focus nor gmat_classic is set from it; the prior Clear Admit attribution of 655 to Class of 2027 Focus could not be confirmed officially. GRE is published as 315 median total only, no quant/verbal split. International is published as 17 countries represented, not a percentage. Acceptance rate not published. Stats on the program page are not tied to a stated class year, so class_year left blank; year 2026 reflects the page's current 2026-27 admissions cycle content. Mendoza lists a 655 median GMAT with no edition label on its official page; not recorded per the edition-ambiguity rule. The class label was stored as a bare 2027 and printed as the Class of 2027, and the page's 85 Average Cohort Size as that class's enrollment (INC-0147); the page names no class, so the label now says so and class_size is empty, since an average cohort size is not a class's enrollment.
